description: This file defines a route component for viewing and editing a note in a note management system, including loader and action functions for server-side data fetching and mutations, and a React component for UI rendering.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Defines dynamic metadata for the route page, setting the document title based on the note data.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches note data based on route parameters; throws 404 if not found.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submissions for deleting or updating the note.

methods.name: NoteDetail
methods.description: React component rendering note editing UI with form controls for title and content, delete button, and save button.

methods.name: ErrorBoundary
methods.description: Error boundary UI for unexpected errors during note loading.

methods.name: CatchBoundary
methods.description: UI displayed when the note is not found (404).
